sources.title: Custom text classification - Foundry Tools | Microsoft Learn
sources.snippet: Custom text classification enables users to build custom AI models to classify text into custom classes predefined by the user. By creating a custom text classification project, developers can iteratively label data, train, evaluate, and improve model performance before making it available for consumption.
